tools.name: environmental-intelligence_carbon-emission-factor-normalize
tools.description: Normalize caller-supplied emission factors with source, version, and asOf provenance when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Disclosed public-style DEFRA/eGRID references may be listed when no factors are supplied. No paid ESG database. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, facto

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_scope-1-emissions-calculate
tools.description: Calculate Scope 1 emissions from caller-supplied activity quantities and emission factors (or disclosed public-style factors when unmatched) when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Factor source, version, and asOf are echoed. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and othe

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_scope-2-emissions-calculate
tools.description: Calculate Scope 2 emissions from electricity activities and caller factors, disclosed public-style grid factors, or optional key-free Carbon Intensity API intensity when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. Returns checkedAt

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_scope-3-supplier-data-validate
tools.description: Validate caller-supplied Scope 3 supplier emission rows for identity, period, quantity, and factor provenance when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Recalculates when activity quantity and a factor are available. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. HTTP 200

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_carbon-report-consistency-check
tools.description: Compare reported Scope 1–3 totals to summed scope values from caller-supplied reports and/or calculated activities when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Flags inconsistent totals within tolerance. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. Returns checkedAt, repo

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_water-consumption-anomaly-detect
tools.description: Detect anomalous water consumption using z-scores on caller-supplied facility water quantity series when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. Returns checkedAt, seriesCount, anomalyCount, items, paidProviderUsed, apiKeyRequi

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_water-intensity-calculate
tools.description: Calculate water intensity (m³ per denominator unit) from caller-supplied water quantities and production/occupancy denominators when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. Returns checkedAt, recordCount, items, paidProviderUse

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_permit-expiry-check
tools.description: Check caller-supplied environmental permit expiry dates against asOf and a warning window when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Compliance determinations are not made. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. Returns checkedAt, permitCount, expiredCount, expiri

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_waste-manifest-reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile shipper and receiver waste manifest rows by manifest number, waste code, unit, and quantity when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. Returns checkedAt, manifestCount, reconciledCount, items, paidProviderUsed, apiK

tools.name: environmental-intelligence_evidence-report
tools.description: Aggregate emission-factor, Scope 1–3, carbon-report, water, permit, and waste sections from caller-supplied operational records (and optional Carbon Intensity fetch) when reviewing environmental or carbon evidence. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, factors and others. HTTP 200 with st
